events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', an anthem of peace and unity. Its message still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Musician Sting, frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Influence
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his solo work, his impact on music is undeniable. What's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got an iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed how we listen to music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Theme Tune
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating all things 007. What's your ultimate Bond theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, what's your top John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic double album, 'The Beatles' (commonly known as 'The White Album'), on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Tracks
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen.

angles.name: Freddie's Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles redefined pop music with 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly broke new ground. What's your top track from it?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a musical icon. John Lennon's spirit lives on through his incredible songs. What's his most impactful lyric for you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Artistry
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the unparalleled artistry of David Bowie. A true chameleon of music. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Happy 92nd heavenly birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley! The King's influence on music is eternal. What's your favourite Elvis track to get you all shook up?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! His riffs with Led Zeppelin are iconic. What's your favourite Page guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic singer Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive voice and rock 'n' roll career, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's Hits
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! His incredible career has given us so many hits. Which one always gets you singing along?
